column1: Left clicking on the map will always be a movement. Right clicking will always be an interaction.
column2: 左键点击地图永远是移动。右键点击永远是互动。

column1: Objects that can be interacted with will show feedback text when you mouse over them. Unless you are telekinetic, you have to get close in order to interact.
column2: 可以互动的物件在鼠标悬停时会显示提示。除非你会念动，否则必须靠近才能互动。

column1: There is a guard waiting in the next room, and you will have to fight him.
column2: 隔壁房间有个守卫等着，你得跟他打一架。

column1: People with high "Fight" or "Hunt" ratings will deal lots of damage in close combat, while people with high "Guard" or "Dodge" ratings are good at soaking or avoiding it.
column2: “格斗”或“狩猎”高的人近战伤害很高，“守护”或“闪避”高的人则擅长硬扛或躲开伤害。

column1: People with a high "Blast" rating can do a lot of damage when they are not in close combat, and a high "Ward" rating allows you to heal wounds and disrupt enemy magic.
column2: “施法”高的人在不近身时也能造成大量伤害，“护佑”高则能治疗伤口、干扰敌人的魔法。

column1: Try to position fighters so that the enemy is forced to come to you. This lets you have the first strike in close combat.
column2: 尽量让敌人不得不朝你走过来。这样近战时你就能先手。

column1: Sometimes, having someone in close combat who just defends themselves is more helpful than having them attack!
column2: 有时候，近战里有个人只顾防守，比让他进攻更有用！

column1: Right-click an item on the ground to pick it up, then drop it on an inventory or equipment slot.
column2: 右键点击地上的物品拾取，再把它放到物品栏或装备栏。

column1: Accessories, like the torch, are equipped in your utility slot, represented by the small hammer icon.
column2: 饰品，比如火把，装备在辅助栏，就是那个小锤子图标。

column1: In order for you to move beyond an area, you must secure it. This requires that you eliminate all hostile creatures and explore the entire layout.
column2: 要离开一片区域，必须先肃清它。这需要消灭所有敌对生物，并探明整张地图。

column1: Move toward the red edges on your minimap in order to explore. Sometimes though, you get lucky and have the map provided for you, like now.
column2: 朝小地图上的红色边缘走，就能探索。不过有时候你会走运，地图直接就给你了，比如现在。

column1: You won't be getting any help with the hostile creatures, however.
column2: 不过，敌对生物可不会有人替你解决。

column1: You can change equipment as much as you want in combat, but only during your own turn.
column2: 战斗中你可以随意更换装备，但只能在你自己的回合。

column1: This kind of key is generic, and will fit any door that requires a normal key.
column2: 这种钥匙是通用的，任何需要普通钥匙的门都能开。

column1: If you can't complete a challenge on your own, you can always have one of your party members try.
column2: 你要是自己完成不了挑战，随时可以让一名队员来试。

column1: A torch can be equipped in your accessory slot. Accessories have lots of different effects, so try them out.
column2: 火把可以装备在饰品栏。饰品效果各不相同，不妨都试试。

column1: Armour goes in the middle equipment slot. You can have only a single protective item equipped at once.
column2: 护甲放在中间的装备栏。一次只能装备一件防护物品。

column1: You're marked as a criminal now, but you never know when coin could come in handy. Best keep as much of it as you can find.
column2: 你现在已经被打上罪犯的标记，但谁知道什么时候用得上钱。能找到多少就留多少。

column1: A door displaying a gear icon is locked by a mechanism. This usually means you will need to find a switch somewhere that will release the lock.
column2: 带齿轮图标的门被机关锁住了。通常你得在某处找到开关才能解开。

column1: A reckless action increases your risk gauge every time you perform one, but it only ends your turn if you fumble. The more risk you have, the more likely a fumble will occur. Fumbled actions fail and expose you to extra damage until your next turn.
column2: 鲁莽行动每次都会提高风险槽，但只有失手才会结束你的回合。风险越高，越容易失手。失手的行动会失败，并让你在下回合之前更容易挨打。

column1: A small iron key has been left on the table here.
column2: 桌上留着一把小铁钥匙。

column1: Any items left on the floor will disappear when you leave, however, so make sure you haven't left anything that you'd rather keep.
column2: 不过，离开时留在地上的物品会消失，所以别落下想留的东西。

column1: Cautious actions will never fumble, regardless of risk, but they will immediately end your turn.
column2: 谨慎行动无论风险多高都不会失手，但会立刻结束你的回合。

column1: Daredevils, however, contribute bonus experience to the party, so it may, on occasion, be worthwhile to throw caution to the wind. Experiment some.
column2: 不过，勇猛会给队伍带来额外经验，所以偶尔值得把谨慎抛到一边。自己试试。

column1: Disabling this mechanism is a guile challenge. If your Thwart skill is high enough, you can attempt it, but you may injure yourself trying.
column2: 拆除这个机关是诡诈挑战。破解够高就可以尝试，但失败可能会受伤。

column1: Food is reasonably plentiful and cannot be used in combat, so use it to keep your health topped-up.
column2: 食物相当充足，而且不能在战斗中使用，所以拿来把生命补满吧。

column1: Getting an excellent result on a challenge gives bonus experience and other rewards, if the person challenging is properly qualified.
column2: 挑战取得出色结果会给予额外经验和别的奖励，前提是挑战者够资格。

column1: Give your party members a chance to evaluate their surroundings by holding still. Your party members will find the key to this door if you let them.
column2: 站着别动，让队员打量四周。你要是让他们看，他们会找到这扇门的钥匙。

column1: If neither of your party members are qualified for these challenges, you'll have to find the switch.
column2: 要是两个队员都不够资格做这些挑战，你就得去找开关。

column1: If someone was injured in the fight with that guard, select that person with the TAB key or number keys 1-4, and then right-click and hold to eat the sandwich.
column2: 如果有人在跟那个守卫的战斗里受了伤，用 TAB 或数字键 1-4 选中他，然后按住右键吃掉三明治。

column1: In the light of the fire, you can see something glinting inside the woodpile. A search reveals a small stash of coin!
column2: 火光下，柴堆里有东西在闪光。翻一翻，是一小笔钱！

column1: In this case, you can bypass the mechanism by succeeding on one of three challenges.
column2: 这一次，三个挑战里成功一个就能绕过机关。

column1: It says : \nI've finally worked out the spell that will open that damned mechanical door. Now I just need to wait for the right moment to use it.
column2: 上面写着：\n我终于琢磨出能打开那扇该死机械门的法术了。现在只差一个合适的时机。

column1: Like food, potions restore health, and often have other beneficial effects. Unlike food, potions can be used in combat, so they are great for emergencies.
column2: 药水和食物一样能回复生命，而且常常还有别的好处。和食物不同，药水可以在战斗中使用，适合救急。

column1: Managing risk effectively by deciding when to be reckless and when to be cautious is the key to success.
column2: 成功的关键，是分清什么时候该鲁莽、什么时候该谨慎，把风险管好。

column1: Once you escape from the Stocks, you will not be able to return. Be sure you are finished before leaving.
column2: 一旦离开枷场，就回不来了。走之前确认事情都办完。

column1: Press the 'R' key, or the spyglass button on the left side of the screen to show you items that may be loose on the floor.
column2: 按 R 键，或点屏幕左侧的望远镜按钮，就能看到地上可能散落的物品。

column1: Still in the grasp of the dusty corpse is a key. It looks like he never got a chance to use it.
column2: 这具落满灰的尸体手里还攥着一把钥匙。看来他没来得及用。

column1: The guard dropped a sandwich. If you haven't already, pick it up and put it in an inventory slot by right clicking it and then clicking a slot.
column2: 守卫掉了一块三明治。还没捡的话，右键捡起来，再点一个物品栏格子放进去。

column1: The remnants of a fire pit. It is still hot, but choked by ashes.
column2: 火塘的残骸。还是热的，但被灰烬堵住了。

column1: There is a large, heavy chain here, meant to be cranked by several people together as an emergency release for the gate.
column2: 这里有一条又大又沉的链子，本来是给几个人一起摇的，用来紧急打开大门。

column1: There is a small hatch in the floor here. It appears to house some kind of mechanism.
column2: 地上有个小舱口，里面好像装着某种机关。

column1: There is an iron key on the table here.
column2: 桌上有一把铁钥匙。

column1: This crank is a force challenge, and can be attempted if your Labour skill is high enough. You may injure yourself if you fail.
column2: 这个摇柄是力量挑战，劳作够高就可以尝试。失败可能会受伤。

column1: This mechanism has been released.
column2: 这个机关已经解开了。

column1: This scroll is a weave challenge. Challenges require points in utility skills, in this case, weave. Be careful though. You can be injured if you fail to overcome a challenge.
column2: 这卷轴是编织挑战。挑战需要辅助技能的点数，这里是编织。当心，失败可能会受伤。

column1: You can only drink a potion on your own turn, but it can used from anybody's backpack, and it doesn't use up your turn, so you can drink a potion and still take another action.
column2: 药水只能在你自己的回合喝，但可以用任何人背包里的，而且不消耗回合，喝完还能再做一个行动。

column1: You finish the spell, and the scroll dissolves.
column2: 你完成了法术，卷轴化掉了。

column1: You have disabled the mechanism. The door should now open.
column2: 你拆除了机关。门现在应该能开了。

column1: You wind the crank fully and latch it into position. The door should now open.
column2: 你把摇柄摇到底并卡住。门现在应该能开了。

column1: You've found an old, battered dagger. Not great, but it's better than nothing.
column2: 你找到一把又旧又破的匕首。不怎么样，总比没有强。

column1: You've noticed the enemies acting in reckless bursts. You can use the SHIFT key in combat when you select your action to perform it recklessly instead.
column2: 你注意到敌人会突然鲁莽地行动。战斗中选择行动时按住 SHIFT，就能改为鲁莽执行。

column1: Your health is fully restored between levels, so there is no need to use up your food before leaving.
column2: 每一关之间生命都会回满，所以离开前不必把食物吃光。
